Answer: F
Reason: The pre-operative chest X-ray (Figure 1a) demonstrates a large right-sided mediastinal mass causing significant displacement of the trachea to the left and shifting of the cardiac silhouette. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) shows resolution of the mass with realignment of both the trachea and heart to their normal anatomical positions, confirming that the mass caused displacement of both structures which was corrected by excision.
